title: Comma Salix Runtime
description: Salix domain, Triage, VM, LLM, reporting, and recovery signals. All Salix metrics are lazy; only workload scrape health is required.

panels.title: Workload scrape health
panels.description: Required health for the workload that runs Salix. Missing series is a collection failure and is never synthesized as zero.

options.content:
Every Salix signal below is event-driven or lazily created, including reporting queue depth. No data is not converted to zero.

Use the required workload health above and [Platform Overview](/d/comma-staging-platform-overview) for scrape, rollout, resource, and shared dependency context. Cloud Monitoring owns platform paging; the two bounded LLM queries below also feed staging-only Grafana P2 rules.

- [Telemetry contracts](https://github.com/AFK-surf/Comma/blob/main/docs/observability.md)

panels.title: Operations traffic / outcomes
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Domain traffic and error outcomes are grouped by bounded component, operation, surface, and outcome.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (workload, component, operation, surface, outcome) (rate(salix_operations_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m]))

panels.title: Operations p95 latency
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Latency is computed from histogram buckets.

promQLQuery.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (workload, le, component, surface) (rate(salix_operations_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m])))

panels.title: VM operations traffic / outcomes
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. VM traffic and error outcomes are grouped by bounded surface, provider, operation, and outcome.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (workload, surface, provider, operation, outcome) (rate(salix_vm_operations_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m]))

panels.title: VM operation p95 latency
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Latency is computed from histogram buckets.

promQLQuery.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (workload, le, surface, provider, operation) (rate(salix_vm_operations_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m])))

panels.title: LLM logical requests / attempts
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Logical request and provider-attempt rates remain separate so retries are visible without reconstructing business state.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (workload, surface, provider, model_key, outcome) (rate(salix_llm_requests_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m]))
sum by (workload, surface, provider, model_key, outcome) (rate(salix_llm_attempts_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m]))

panels.title: LLM attempt p95 latency
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Provider attempt latency uses the current singular attempt metric name.

promQLQuery.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (workload, le, surface, provider, model_key) (rate(salix_llm_attempt_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m])))

panels.title: LLM TTFT p95
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Time to first token is computed from histogram buckets.

promQLQuery.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (workload, le, surface, provider, model_key) (rate(salix_llm_ttft_seconds_bucket{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m])))

panels.title: LLM token rate
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Tokens are grouped only by bounded surface, provider, model key, and kind.

promQLQuery.expr: sum by (workload, surface, provider, model_key, kind) (rate(salix_llm_tokens_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m]))

panels.title: Reporting queue depth
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Queue depth itself is lazy and must not be treated as a required zero-valued gauge.

panels.title: Reporting rejection / drop rate
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Queue-full events and dropped rows are shown without inventing a capacity threshold.

panels.title: Reporting flush p95
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Flush latency is computed from histogram buckets.

panels.title: Reporting flush failures
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Count non-ok flush completions as failures.

panels.title: VM state transitions
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Transition rates are grouped by bounded surface, provider, and state.

panels.title: VM recovery scan work
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Recovery scans are work signals, not a reconstructed runtime state projection.

panels.title: External status projections
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Projection outcomes expose write failures without scanning business records.

panels.title: Derived-storage convergence passes
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Sustained error outcomes need triage: before first completion they mean the derived data cannot converge (readiness held); after the durable completed_ever fact, a failed completion-marker write also reports error while readiness stays true (scheduling state only).

panels.title: Derived-storage convergence work
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Converged volume is bootstrap progress on first pass and drift healing afterwards; failed records block pass completion.

panels.title: S3 settlement outcomes
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. CAS and create-once ambiguity settlement is bounded. Sustained indeterminate or error outcomes mean the read-back budget is exhausting or storage is failing; precondition_failed and exists are proved competing-owner results.

options.content:
**Grafana evaluates the adjacent queries as staging P2 rules; the panels themselves only explain the signals. Cloud Monitoring remains the platform paging owner.**

- Logical-request error ratio: above 10% with at least 10 requests in 15 minutes.
- LLM TTFT p95: above 30 seconds with at least 20 TTFT samples in 15 minutes.

A point shows the current 15-minute window breaching. Grafana sends FIRING/RESOLVED to `#comma-app-alerts` only after the condition remains true for 15 continuous minutes. TTFT is provider-attempt and workload-wide; a missing billing surface currently normalizes to `system`. Do not infer end-to-end customer or surface impact from a point.

panels.title: LLM logical error breach
panels.description: Exact query used by staging P2 rule comma-stg-llm-error. A point is the 15-minute logical-request error ratio only when it exceeds 10% and the same window contains at least 10 requests.

promQLQuery.expr: (((((sum by (workload) (increase(salix_llm_requests_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma",outcome="error"}[15m]))) or on(workload) (0 * (sum by (workload) (increase(salix_llm_requests_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[15m]))))) / (sum by (workload) (increase(salix_llm_requests_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[15m])))) > 0.1) and on(workload) ((sum by (workload) (increase(salix_llm_requests_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[15m]))) >= 10)) or on(workload) (0 * (sum by (workload) (increase(salix_llm_requests_total{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[15m]))))

panels.title: LLM TTFT breach
panels.description: Exact query used by staging P2 rule bfsralwg6q1hcd. A point is the 15-minute provider-attempt p95 only when it exceeds 30 seconds and the same window contains at least 20 TTFT samples. It is not end-to-end user latency.

promQLQuery.expr: (((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (workload, le) (rate(salix_llm_ttft_seconds_bucket{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[15m])))) > 30) and on(workload) ((sum by (workload) (increase(salix_llm_ttft_seconds_count{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[15m]))) >= 20)) or on(workload) (0 * (sum by (workload) (increase(salix_llm_ttft_seconds_count{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[15m]))))

panels.title: User-dependency job outcomes
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Timeout, saturation, and crash outcomes identify unhealthy user-owned dependencies without consuming agent-core capacity.

panels.title: Dependency and event pressure
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Compare active dependency work with detached Connector event backlog; sustained pressure should be read with timeout and saturation outcomes.

panels.title: Connector external-event outcomes
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Completion and terminal/cache-hit outcomes should keep pace with accepted and retry outcomes; sustained retry, timeout, or saturation indicates dependency trouble.

panels.title: Connector ownership cleanup
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Pending RPC and stream outcomes expose caller, deadline, capacity, and transport cleanup without high-cardinality operation identities.

panels.title: Triage phase outcomes
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Native-Triage progress and failures are grouped by bounded phase, outcome, and source mode labels.

panels.title: Triage phase p95 latency
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Native-Triage phase latency is computed from histogram buckets.

promQLQuery.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (workload, le, phase, outcome) (rate(salix_triage_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="comma",workload="comma"}[5m])))

panels.title: Triage recovery backlog
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Backlog is a bounded continuation-presence signal (0 or 1), not an exact global queue depth.

panels.title: Triage recovery record errors
panels.description: Lazy Salix series. No data may mean no matching event occurred; compare the required workload scrape health above. Sustained errors mean unreadable or invalid durable records are preventing a recovery lane from reporting clean progress.

panels.title: Meeting runtime-lost terminalizations
panels.description: Exact query used by staging P2 rule comma-stg-meeting-runtime-lost. A point counts meetings the summary watchdog terminalized as runtime_lost, i.e. attendees received an incomplete-record notice instead of a summary.

panels.title: Meetings stuck without an anchor
panels.description: Exact query used by staging P2 rule comma-stg-meeting-stuck. A point counts dispatched, non-abandoned meetings the watchdog could not safely terminalize because every timestamp anchor was missing.

panels.title: Meeting delivery errors
panels.description: Exact query used by staging P2 rule comma-stg-meeting-delivery-error. Deliveries parked on a disabled connect report the retained outcome and are excluded, so this is genuine failure only.
